description: This file defines the DataResponse class, which models a data response structure following JSON API conventions. It encapsulates properties like type, id, attributes, relationships, and links, providing getters and setters for each. It also implements jsonSerialize() for converting to JSON format.

classes.name: DataResponse
classes.description: Represents a JSON API data response object with properties for type, id, attributes, relationships, and links. Implements jsonSerialize() for JSON conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing type and id properties.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the data response.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the data response.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Prepares the object for JSON encoding, returning an array with the data properties, filtering out null values.
